description:
Get a product's full profile: specs, full description, feature bullets, ratings, price,
trend, dimension scores/percentiles, per-claim user-review facts check (facts_check),
feature-level review verification (product_features), red-flag signals, and sentiment.
profile.full_description carries the complete listing description paragraph when available
in the source listing; otherwise it is null (specifications and feature_bullets remain present).
product_features lists one record per seller-claimed feature in the seller's own order, each
carrying its own user-review verdict; it is kept separate from feature_factors (category-level
decision factors) and the two are never merged.
name: get_product
